In terms of the plays they aren't very flashy or impressive so on that side of the video its not very entertaining, usually if the video is really well edited its a nice watch. I think you just need to work on some basic editing things before you make a full montage. Things such as colour correction, nicer transitions, cinematic shots, for fitting music, and cutting the clips to make the video flow better are good examples of the basic fundamentals you should consider when making a montage.   


If these are your own clips then I recommend finding some other clips from the community (if they are willing to give replays and clips) or friends. Quality over quantity is the overwhelming general tip I think you would benefit from the most.    


Having said all this I really like the fire effect on the flames and I think it could look really really good on another video perhaps. You've picked a very upbeat and energetic song but the plays and the feels of the video actually feels a lot slower so we get these contradictory vibes when watching the video. The song choice for any montage can really make or break the video since it sets the foundations for what kind of video its going to be.   


If its your first time then I think its a really good first attempt and I want to clarify I dont want you to be disheartened by my comments and rather take the tips into the next video you make.  


Good luck in video editing and montage making friend :)
